boundary_method.analysis_region: Yukon admin-1 boundary from Natural Earth 1:10m
boundary_method.buffer_role: Computational extraction aid only; the buffer is not part of the analysis region.
boundary_method.edge_cell_method: ERA5-Land cells intersecting Yukon are retained. Yukon-wide averages use the area of each grid cell intersecting the unbuffered Yukon polygon as the spatial weight.
boundary_method.final_map_clip: Raster rendering is clipped to the unbuffered Yukon polygon.

yukon_summary: Area-weighted mean of ERA5-Land grid-cell indicator values using the fraction of each cell within the Yukon boundary.
community_summary: Community products use the existing 18 Yukon ERA5-Land community grid-cell series.
trend_method: Mean temperature, mean daily maximum temperature, and mean daily minimum temperature use ordinary least-squares linear trends with lag-1 HAC/Newey-West uncertainty. Other temperature indicators use Sen's slope to estimate trend magnitude and the Mann-Kendall test to assess statistical significance. For Sen/Mann-Kendall analyses, the Hamed-Rao variance correction is applied only when significant lag-1 serial correlation is detected after detrending. Statistical significance is assessed at p < 0.05. For Yukon maps, Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction is applied across grid cells. Community heatmaps use the same multiple-testing control across communities.
community_multiple_testing: Community significance is additionally reported using Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction within each indicator.
heatmap_design: Rows are Yukon communities. Seasonal columns are shown first where available, followed by Annual. Values are physical slopes per decade; Temperature uses a blue-white-red diverging scale. Parentheses indicate results that are not significant after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across communities.

mean-temperature.label: Mean temperature
mean-temperature.description: Average daily temperature over the year.
mean-temperature.definition: Annual mean of daily mean 2 m air temperature.

mean-daily-maximum-temperature.label: Mean daily maximum temperature
mean-daily-maximum-temperature.description: Average of the daily high temperatures over the year.
mean-daily-maximum-temperature.definition: Annual mean of daily maximum 2 m air temperature.

mean-daily-minimum-temperature.label: Mean daily minimum temperature
mean-daily-minimum-temperature.description: Average of the daily low temperatures over the year.
mean-daily-minimum-temperature.definition: Annual mean of daily minimum 2 m air temperature.

coldest-night.label: Coldest night
coldest-night.description: Lowest daily minimum temperature reached during the year.
coldest-night.definition: Annual minimum of daily minimum 2 m air temperature.

hottest-day.label: Hottest day
hottest-day.description: Highest daily maximum temperature reached during the year.
hottest-day.definition: Annual maximum of daily maximum 2 m air temperature.

days-above-20c.label: Days above 20°C
days-above-20c.description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 20°C.
days-above-20c.definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 20°C.

days-above-25c.label: Days above 25°C
days-above-25c.description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 25°C.
days-above-25c.definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 25°C.

days-above-30c.label: Days above 30°C
days-above-30c.description: Number of days each year when the daily high is above 30°C.
days-above-30c.definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature > 30°C.

nights-above-10c.label: Nights above 10°C
nights-above-10c.description: Number of days each year when the daily low stays above 10°C.
nights-above-10c.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature > 10°C.

nights-above-15c.label: Nights above 15°C
nights-above-15c.description: Number of days each year when the daily low stays above 15°C.
nights-above-15c.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature > 15°C.

nights-below-minus-20c.label: Nights below -20°C
nights-below-minus-20c.description: Number of days each year when the daily low falls below -20°C.
nights-below-minus-20c.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -20°C.

nights-below-minus-30c.label: Nights below -30°C
nights-below-minus-30c.description: Number of days each year when the daily low falls below -30°C.
nights-below-minus-30c.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -30°C.

nights-below-minus-40c.label: Nights below -40°C
nights-below-minus-40c.description: Number of days each year when the daily low falls below -40°C.
nights-below-minus-40c.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < -40°C.

frost-days.label: Frost days
frost-days.description: Number of days each year with a minimum temperature below freezing.
frost-days.definition: Count of days with daily minimum 2 m air temperature < 0°C.

ice-days.label: Ice days
ice-days.description: Number of days each year when the temperature stays below freezing all day.
ice-days.definition: Count of days with daily maximum 2 m air temperature < 0°C.

freeze-thaw-days.label: Freeze-thaw days
freeze-thaw-days.description: Number of days that cross freezing, with a low below 0°C and a high above 0°C.
freeze-thaw-days.definition: Count of days with daily minimum temperature < 0°C and daily maximum temperature > 0°C.

frost-free-season-length.label: Frost-free season length
frost-free-season-length.description: Length of the frost-free period between spring and fall. Values are temporarily under review.
frost-free-season-length.definition: Under review. This indicator will be recalculated using a non-overlapping midsummer split between the last spring frost and first fall frost.
frost-free-season-length.review_note: Temporarily withheld from public trend views pending recalculation of the frost-free-season definition.

growing-degree-days-above-0c.label: Growing degree days above 0°C
growing-degree-days-above-0c.description: Accumulated warmth above 0°C over the year.
growing-degree-days-above-0c.definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 0°C, 0), in °C·days.

growing-degree-days-above-5c.label: Growing degree days above 5°C
growing-degree-days-above-5c.description: Accumulated warmth above 5°C over the year.
growing-degree-days-above-5c.definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 5°C, 0), in °C·days.

heating-degree-days-below-18c.label: Heating degree days below 18°C
heating-degree-days-below-18c.description: Accumulated cold relative to 18°C, an indicator of heating demand.
heating-degree-days-below-18c.definition: Annual sum of max(18°C - daily mean temperature, 0), in °C·days.

cooling-degree-days-above-18c.label: Cooling degree days above 18°C
cooling-degree-days-above-18c.description: Accumulated warmth relative to 18°C, an indicator of cooling demand.
cooling-degree-days-above-18c.definition: Annual sum of max(daily mean temperature - 18°C, 0), in °C·days.

map_note: Black dots indicate grid cells where the trend is not statistically significant after spatial multiple-testing control.
boundary_summary: Yukon admin-1 boundary from Natural Earth 1:10m. A 50 km buffer is used only to extract source data; final statistics and maps use the unbuffered boundary.
yukon_value_note: Each indicator is calculated at each ERA5-Land grid cell, then area-weighted across Yukon. For counts and extremes, the Yukon value is a spatial average of local indicator values, not a territory-wide event count.
